project_name: MyGenie POS Reports - Cancellations UI Redesign Blueprint
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: 1. Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`), use specific properties instead. 2. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. 3. Avoid AI slop aesthetics; do not center-align the app container. 4. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers or overlays. 5. Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). 6. Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for structural layouts; customize components heavily if used. 7. Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns. 8. Use standard Lucide icons, never emoji characters.

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif, text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-zinc-950
typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure letter spacing is tight for headings. Table headers must remain uppercase and legible. Maintain existing typography scales.

colors.backgrounds: bg-white for cards, bg-zinc-50 for app background and table headers
colors.borders: border-zinc-200 for cards, border-zinc-100 for internal dividers
colors.text: text-zinc-950 for primary text, text-zinc-500 for secondary, text-red-600 for loss amounts
colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the neutral zinc palette strictly. Use the specified risk tier colors to explicitly indicate the duration severity.

visual_enhancers.badges: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 inline-flex items-center gap-1
visual_enhancers.filter_bar: bg-white border border-zinc-200 rounded-xl p-4 flex gap-3 flex-wrap items-center shadow-sm
visual_enhancers.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure that badges have visual contrast against the table row. The filter bar should stand out slightly with a subtle shadow.

grids.instructions_to_main_agent: Use flex layouts for the filter bar to allow responsive wrapping. Use table elements for tabular data.

cancellations_report.before: Table with 13 separate columns overflowing horizontally. Punch Time and Duration are hidden off-screen. No column filters.
cancellations_report.after: Consolidated 7-column table layout: 1. Order Info (Order #, Date). 2. Item Details (Item Name, Scope Badge). 3. Reason & Notes (Reason, Notes icon, Cancel Note icon). 4. Stage (Stage Badge). 5. Amount (Loss in red). 6. Personnel (Cancelled By, Station). 7. Timing & Risk (Punch Time, Duration, Risk Badge). Added a Filter Bar above the table.

cancel_detail_report.before: Table with 8 columns. Missing Punch Time and Duration entirely. Only Stage and Reason dropdowns present.
cancel_detail_report.after: Consolidated 7-column table layout for parity: 1. Order Info (Order #, Date). 2. Item Details (Item Name, Qty). 3. Stage (Stage Badge). 4. Loss (Amount in red). 5. Reason (Reason text). 6. Personnel (By). 7. Timing & Risk (Punch Time, Duration, Risk Badge). Expanded Filter Bar to include all 5 metrics.

layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Implement table cell merging on both screens to reduce the column count. Add the filter bar pattern immediately above the tables.

motion.hover_states: hover:bg-zinc-50/50 on table rows, hover:bg-zinc-100 on filter dropdowns
motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Use targeted transitions like `transition-colors` instead of `transition-all`. Exclude transforms from universal transition definitions.

accessibility.contrast: Risk badges and text must maintain a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their backgrounds.
accessibility.attributes: Add `data-testid` to all filter inputs and risk badges.
accessibility.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dropdowns have solid backgrounds to avoid overlap transparency issues. Ensure all new merged columns are readable by screen readers.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Clock for doubt, AlertTriangle for risk, ShieldAlert or XCircle for high_risk. MessageSquare for Notes.
media.instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use placeholder URLs. Do not use emoji characters.

3d_libraries_and_steps.instructions_to_main_agent: Do not introduce 3D or WebGL rendering.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a blueprint. Execute the changes to fix BUG-713, CR-554, CR-555, and CR-556. Use `.js`/`.jsx` files syntax. The goal is parity across both screens using the new 7-column layout, implementing the duration risk badges, and adding the comprehensive filter bar.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Prioritize using pre-existing components and styles. 2. Implement exact visual matching for the zinc palette. 3. Add `data-testid` uniformly to all elements.

bug_713_and_cr_554_column_consolidation.strategy: Merge low-value columns into secondary lines within primary columns to eliminate horizontal scroll.
proposed_columns:
Timing & Risk:
{punchTime}
{duration} min{riskBadge}

cr_555_risk_badge_system.logic: Duration = (Cancel Time - Punch Time) in minutes.

cr_556_filter_bar_pattern.layout: A flex container placed directly above the table component. Background white, rounded-xl, padding 4.
